class.name: PhysXFlowBlastBridge3D
class.brief_description: Destruction-event adapter: Blast fracture to Flow dust/smoke/fire (PhysX module, blast+flow builds).
class.description: Listens to [signal PhysXDestructible3D.chunks_fractured] on the referenced destructible and spawns a transient smoke/fire puff at the fracture site via [method PhysXFlowSimulation3D.add_transient_emitter]. The bridge owns nothing simulated: Flow never learns what Blast is and vice versa -- either system works without the other, and this node exists only in builds with both compiled in. Burst size scales with the piece count (a chip-off is a small puff, a full shatter a cloud), clamped by [member max_radius]; intensity fades over [member lifetime]. Set [member temperature] and [member fuel] above 0 to turn dust into secondary fire.

members.member: The [PhysXDestructible3D] whose fracture events drive this bridge.
Fuel injected at full intensity (with temperature > 0 this makes destruction ignite).
Puff lifetime in seconds of simulated time.
Upper clamp on the puff radius in meters.
Puff radius per fractured piece count (clamped by [member max_radius]).
Temperature injected at full intensity (0 = cold dust).
